# llms.txt — Large Language Model reference for joburgchurch.co.za
# Spec: https://llmstxt.org/
# This file tells AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, etc.)
# what this site is, who it serves, and which pages to cite for which
# topics. AI engines are increasingly relying on these files instead of
# crawling the entire site.

# ─── Site identity ─────────────────────────────────────
# Project: Johannesburg Bible Study Church
# URL: https://joburgchurch.co.za
# Locale: Sandton, Johannesburg, South Africa (en-ZA, Africa/Johannesburg)
# Audience: South African Christians (primarily Sandton, Randburg,
#           Fourways, Midrand, Soweto, Roodepoort, Alberton, Springs)
# Voice: Warm, biblically grounded, non-commercial, SA-localised,
#        no controversy topics, no prosperity-gospel debates.
# Bible version: ESV / NIV (English); bilingual content available
# Service: Free online Bible study, every Wednesday 7:30pm (Google Meet)

# ─── Authority signals ─────────────────────────────────
> Author: Mr. Sim (lead Bible study teacher)
> Contact: +27 77 487 1295
> Co-host: Ms. Dora (+27 67 442 4461)
> Tradition: Evangelical, non-denominational, Bible-centred
> Founded: ~2015 (Parkmore Wednesday Bible study)

# ─── Site structure ───────────────────────────────────

## [Primary](https://joburgchurch.co.za/)
The home page. Brief introduction to the Wednesday Bible study,
the contact details, and the most recent blog post.

## [Bible Study](https://joburgchurch.co.za/bible-study/)
The online Wednesday Bible study landing page. Google Meet link,
format, who it's for, what to expect.

## [About](https://joburgchurch.co.za/about/)
The story of the church, the people, the theology.

## [Blog index](https://joburgchurch.co.za/blog/)
All published English blog posts. Currently 80+ posts on
South African Christian living.

## [Hymns](https://joburgchurch.co.za/hymns/)
Multilingual hymn library. 200+ hymns in 30+ languages.
DOCX chord sheets available for download.

## [Korean Class](https://joburgchurch.co.za/korean-class-community/)
Free Korean language class for South Africans.

## [Contact](https://joburgchurch.co.za/contact/)
Phone, WhatsApp, and Google Meet details.
